newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends down against dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends down against dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2894 on Tuesday against the dollar in Shanghai, from a 27-month high of 8.2882 on Monday, due to a technical correction, dealers said.
The central bank was not seen intervening to depress the yuan on Monday, they said.
"After sharp gains in the yuan over the past few trading days, profit-taking emerged today to push it down," one dealer said. "The central bank did not intervene," he said.
"A technical correction was necessary after it set a 27-month high on Monday," another dealer said.
